name: Default
description: Default texture pack — 16x16 pixel-art tiles for the Game One material library. World scale: 10 cm per voxel (10 vox/m), so each tile is the surface of a 10 cm voxel face. Includes terrain + vegetation/tree materials (ids 24-31, currently placeholders). Source images nearest-neighbour-downscaled into a 16px-per-tile atlas.
